Read-only audit of the published release matching the archived comparison log.
This notebook downloads a hash-pinned source archive, reads an explicit member
allowlist and records relevant source lines. It never imports, installs or
executes the downloaded software, reruns clustering, or changes analysis data.
Published defaults and the archived invocation are separate evidence; they do
not alone prove that the historical installed package was unmodified.

Run from the repository root with a new output directory:

```sh
python scripts/run_python_qmd.py manuscript/instrain_release_source_audit.qmd NEW_OUTPUT
```

## Retrieve and verify the exact release

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import tarfile
import urllib.request

out = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
if out.exists():
    raise SystemExit("Refusing to overwrite an existing audit directory")
url = "https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/7c/60/fa58b8433042e84400cdb30727c48723b8a9c824719cf2ebae94dde9c311/inStrain-1.10.0.tar.gz"
expected = "f40f1d439914ec85cec83ce4c3f2fbf2ce064132109be9f2d3bfd048899b5a8e"
metadata_url = "https://pypi.org/pypi/inStrain/1.10.0/json"
with urllib.request.urlopen(metadata_url, timeout=60) as response:
    metadata_bytes = response.read(2000000)
metadata = json.loads(metadata_bytes)
record = [r for r in metadata["urls"] if r["filename"] == "inStrain-1.10.0.tar.gz"]
assert len(record) == 1 and metadata["info"]["version"] == "1.10.0"
assert record[0]["url"] == url and record[0]["digests"]["sha256"] == expected
with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60) as response:
    archive_bytes = response.read(2000000)
assert len(archive_bytes) == record[0]["size"] == 1133306
assert hashlib.sha256(archive_bytes).hexdigest() == expected
out.mkdir(parents=True)
(out/"source").mkdir()
(out/"inStrain-1.10.0.tar.gz").write_bytes(archive_bytes)
(out/"pypi_release_metadata.json").write_bytes(metadata_bytes)
(out/"source/instrain_release_source_audit.qmd").write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
```

## Inspect only allowlisted source files, without running them

```{python}
members = ["inStrain/argumentParser.py", "inStrain/genomeUtilities.py",
           "inStrain/compare_controller.py", "inStrain/compare_utils.py",
           "inStrain/SNVprofile.py", "inStrain/_version.py", "LICENSE"]
sources = {}
source_hashes = {}
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive_bytes), mode="r:gz") as archive:
    for relative in members:
        member = archive.getmember("inStrain-1.10.0/"+relative)
        assert member.isfile() and member.size < 2000000
        raw = archive.extractfile(member).read()
        target = out/"source"/relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(raw)
        sources[relative] = raw.decode("utf-8")
        source_hashes[relative] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

# AST literal inspection, not evaluation of package code.
defaults = {}
for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(sources["inStrain/argumentParser.py"])):
    if not isinstance(node, ast.Call) or not isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) or node.func.attr != "add_argument":
        continue
    flags = [a.value for a in node.args if isinstance(a, ast.Constant) and isinstance(a.value, str)]
    for flag in ("--ani_threshold", "--coverage_treshold", "--clusterAlg"):
        if flag in flags:
            value = [ast.literal_eval(k.value) for k in node.keywords if k.arg == "default"]
            assert len(value) == 1 and flag not in defaults
            defaults[flag] = {"default": value[0], "line": node.lineno}
assert set(defaults) == {"--ani_threshold", "--coverage_treshold", "--clusterAlg"}
patterns = re.compile(r"percent_compared|coverage_treshold|ani_threshold|clusterAlg|compared_bases_count|genome_length|StbError|no_length")
excerpts = []
for relative, source in sources.items():
    for number, line in enumerate(source.splitlines(), 1):
        if patterns.search(line):
            excerpts.append({"file": relative, "line": number, "text": line.strip()})
(out/"source_evidence.json").write_text(json.dumps(excerpts, indent=2)+"\n")
```

## Bind the release evidence to the archived invocation

```{python}
repo = Path.cwd()
data = Path(os.environ.get("PHAGE_UV_DATA_ROOT", "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569")).resolve(strict=True)
log = data/"community_uv_response/variant_analysis/instrain_priority_20/compare/all_samples/log/log.log"
raw_log = log.read_bytes()
lines = raw_log.decode().splitlines()
commands = [line for line in lines if "Command to run inStrain was:" in line]
versions = [line for line in lines if "inStrain version" in line]
assert len(commands) == len(versions) == 1 and "1.10.0 was run" in versions[0]
assert not any(flag in commands[0] for flag in defaults)
assert any("inStrain compare finished" in line for line in lines)
summary = {
    "status": "published_release_and_invocation_verified_pending_semantic_review",
    "release": "1.10.0", "metadata_url": metadata_url, "archive_url": url,
    "archive_sha256": expected, "archive_bytes": len(archive_bytes),
    "published_defaults": defaults, "source_sha256": source_hashes,
    "log_path": str(log), "log_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw_log).hexdigest(),
    "archived_command": commands[0], "archived_version": versions[0],
    "explicit_cluster_threshold_overrides": False,
    "completed_log_marker": True,
    "missing_scaffold_length_log_lines": sum("StbError" in line and "no_length" in line for line in lines),
    "limitation": "Version and invocation match; the exact historical installed source has not been recovered. Published defaults are not direct proof of resolved runtime values."
}
(out/"audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in summary.items() if k not in ("archived_command","source_sha256")}, indent=2))
```
